notes: Skills offered from other repositories without copying their files. Each entry pins a repository, commit and folder path, with the digest of that folder computed by the index digest rule, so a client that fetches the folder can check it. The name is the skill's own front-matter name; the description is our own wording. The source repository has no license file, so nothing from it is copied here.
